This house was unlike any other as it was modeled after a 16th-century monastery called \"Forde Abbey\" in England. It was constructed from the same granite as the Grove Park Inn and built at the top of Town Mountain. Seely entertained presidents and political figures at his 20,000 square foot castle when they were in town visiting Grove Park Inn. Over time, the myths and stories about Seely's Castle would grow bigger than the house itself!
